verdicts.reason: A separates the cream circle from the bottle and drops it into the bottom-left corner, cut off by the edge. That leaves an orange-on-orange bottle with almost no contrast, a small headline floating in a mostly empty canvas, left-aligned text next to a centred CTA, and a large gap above 'Out now.'. B keeps the bottle-on-circle motif intact and at a good scale, but 'Out now.' is cut off from the headline and sits alone at the bottom right across from the CTA, the headline is jammed against the top of the circle, and the bottom row feels cramped.
